layout: Historical Grand Prix; replay alignment approximate

provenance.rights: OpenF1: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; non-commercial educational/fan analysis. https://openf1.org/ ; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/ . Modified: joined laps/stints/pits, lap-relative traces and integrated distance; missing fields remain null.

channels.accurate/deleted/trackStatus: unavailable, null; never claimed to be FastF1 flags
channels.car: OpenF1 native samples, speed km/h, throttle %, brake boolean, rpm, gear
channels.position: source broadcast coordinates, not surveyed GPS; no rotation/scale applied
channels.distance: trapezoidal speed integration from first available sample, metres
channels.weather: OpenF1 samples, UTC; no interpolation or zero fill

provenance.missing: null is unavailable; no invented telemetry or flags
provenance.interpolation: No resampling on export. UI interpolation hides gaps over 2 seconds.

warnings: Track-status, deleted-lap and FastF1 accuracy flags are unavailable. The OpenF1 regression uses numerical-consistency, dry-compound, pit and duration filters; it cannot certify green-flag laps.
Observed lap times are real. Ghost replay positions between observations are interpolated; statistical ghosts use illustrative map motion.
